children: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin said privacy is only truly dead if people give up on it, adding that he will not abandon privacy and will instead increase his efforts. According to ChainCatcher, he made the remarks in response to Paradigm CTO Georgios Konstantopoulos' question about what room remains for privacy development.
Buterin previously updated Ethereum's roadmap in August, with quantum security, privacy protection, and native rollups listed as future priorities.

title: Vitalik Buterin Says He Will Continue Prioritizing Privacy
